data: Amazon reported net income of a net loss of $2.7 billion in fiscal 2022 and net income of $59.2 billion in fiscal 2024. Because 2022 was a loss, a conventional percentage change is not meaningful: the swing is a $61.9 billion improvement, moving from a loss of about $2.7 billion (roughly negative 0.5% net margin on $514.0 billion of revenue) to a profit of $59.2 billion (about 9.3% net margin on $638.0 billion of revenue). If you divide the change by the absolute value of the 2022 loss, you get an increase of roughly 2,290%, but that figure should be read as an illustration of scale rather than a true growth rate.
